subject: general
question: With whom did the Indian Army sign a contract worth ₹3131.82 crore for manufacture and supply of missiles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Dynamics Limited.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Dynamics Limited**

 
 
• **​The Indian Army signed a contract worth ₹3131.82 crores for the manufacture and supply of missiles with Bharat Dynamics Limited.**
 
• BDL has the ability to integrate and provide **Anti-Submarine Warfare Suite (ASW Suite)** systems that include fire control systems, torpedoes, and torpedo defence systems.
 
• The aerospace and defence electronics company **Bharat Electronics Limited is owned by the Indian government (BEL)**. It primarily manufactures state-of-the-art electrical products for use in ground and aviation applications.
 
• BEL is one of the nine PSUs that are a part of the Indian Ministry of Defense. In **Vishakhapatnam, Bhanur, and Hyderabad**, the company currently runs three production facilities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Army and Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) **have a contract in place for the production and supply of Konkurs - M anti-tank guided missiles.
 
• On **February 2, a deal for Rs 3,131.82 crores** was inked; it would be completed in three years.
 
• A second-generation mechanised infantry anti-tank guided missile called the **Konkurs-M** is designed to obliterate armoured vehicles with explosive reactive armour.
 
• The missile can be fired from a ground launcher or a **BMP-II tank**. Its range is 75 to 4,000 metres, and its flying time is 19 seconds.
